preconditions.description: The integer n is a positive integer within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= f(i) <= n for all i in [n]
preconditions.description: Each value f(i) is a positive integer within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: m == -1 if no solution exists else 1 <= m <= 10^6
postconditions.description: The output m is -1 if no solution exists, otherwise it is a positive integer within the specified range.
The function g composed with h returns the identity function over the range [m].
The function h composed with g returns the function f over the range [n].
The number of distinct values in g(i) for i in [n] is equal to m.
